requirements.title: A processor may omit evaluation of operands whose values are not needed
requirements.definition: If the value of an expression can be determined otherwise, the processor is not required to evaluate all operands or to evaluate every part of an operand. This is evaluation latitude, not a guarantee of short-circuiting or full evaluation.

pending.operand-evaluation-omission-latitude: PENDING permission record only: future logical, zero-sized-array, or zero-length-string controls may not require an operand to be evaluated merely because it appears in source.
pending.partial-operand-evaluation-omission-lati: PENDING permission record only: future plans must not infer that an entire array, character, or structure operand was evaluated when the expression value can be determined otherwise.
pending.value-determined-otherwise-condition: PENDING source-review plan identifying the standard-defined reason the expression value is determined without the operand. The plan must avoid undefined values and unrelated invalid contexts.
pending.all-expression-classes-caution: PENDING oracle-discipline note that the latitude is not limited to logical expressions; examples do not create a narrower requirement or a short-circuit mandate.
pending.no-short-circuit-or-order-oracle: PENDING negative-oracle guard: side effects, call counters, volatile-looking traces, IO order, and function invocation observations are not portable evidence of operand evaluation.

requirements.oracle: This is a processor permission. Future valid programs and oracles must be invariant whether the processor evaluates the optional operand, skips it, or evaluates only part of it, subject to the rest of the standard.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Future cases must not infer which operand was evaluated, the order of evaluation, or whether an optional evaluation was omitted; must not assert a result that a permitted mathematically or logically equivalent rewrite could change; must not use floating-point tolerance as an escape hatch; must not rely on compiler agreement, address arithmetic, TRANSFER, emitted assembly, or undefined reads; and must attribute every negative to the cited requirement rather than to an independently invalid rule owned elsewhere.

requirements.title: Entities that would be defined by an unneeded function reference become undefined when expression evaluation completes
requirements.definition: When a statement contains a function reference in a part of an expression that need not be evaluated, every entity that would have become defined during execution of that reference becomes undefined at the completion of evaluation of the containing expression.

pending.unneeded-function-reference-context: PENDING source plan locating a function reference in an expression part that need not be evaluated under p1, without assuming whether the processor invokes the function.
pending.would-be-defined-entities: PENDING source analysis identifying each entity that would become defined during execution of the function reference, including dummy arguments with definitional side effects where otherwise permitted.
pending.undefined-at-expression-completion: PENDING effect plan for the completion point of the containing expression. Because reading an undefined value is prohibited as an oracle, this remains pending until a safe source/evidence route is designed.
pending.independent-of-actual-invocation: PENDING oracle discipline: the undefined-status consequence applies no matter whether the function is actually invoked, so no future test may branch on call-count evidence.
pending.no-undefined-read-oracle: PENDING explicit ban on checking the value of an entity after it becomes undefined. Any future admissible evidence must re-define the entity before value use or use a standard-defined inquiry that does not read its undefined value.

requirements.oracle: Future plans must treat the undefined status as the effect. They must not read the undefined entity to prove the effect and must not infer whether the function was invoked.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Future cases must not infer which operand was evaluated, the order of evaluation, or whether an optional evaluation was omitted; must not assert a result that a permitted mathematically or logically equivalent rewrite could change; must not use floating-point tolerance as an escape hatch; must not rely on compiler agreement, address arithmetic, TRANSFER, emitted assembly, or undefined reads; and must attribute every negative to the cited requirement rather than to an independently invalid rule owned elsewhere.

requirements.title: An unneeded function reference shall not execute image control statements other than CRITICAL or END CRITICAL
requirements.definition: If a statement contains a function reference in a part of an expression that need not be evaluated, no invocation of that function in that part of the expression is permitted to execute an image control statement, except for CRITICAL or END CRITICAL.

pending.image-control-ban-in-unneeded-function-r: PENDING restriction plan for a function reference in an expression part that need not be evaluated where an invocation in that part would execute an image control statement. The plan must isolate this p3 rule rather than general coarray or pure-procedure restrictions.
pending.critical-statement-exception: PENDING boundary plan showing that CRITICAL is the named exception to the p3 image-control-statement ban, subject to all separate CRITICAL construct rules.
pending.end-critical-statement-exception: PENDING boundary plan showing that END CRITICAL is the named exception, paired with a valid construct and not used to infer execution order.
pending.avoid-optimization-deadlock-pattern: PENDING source-review rationale preserving NOTE 3: the restriction prevents inadvertent deadlock under optimization. No test may attempt to force or observe a deadlock as evidence.
pending.collective-subroutine-not-this-image-con: PENDING attribution guard after consulting 16.6: collective subroutine references have their own collective restrictions and NOTE 2 says they are not image control statements; do not file collective-call violations under this p3 facet unless another owner makes them image-control statements.

requirements.oracle: Future diagnostics or source reviews must isolate this optimization-safety restriction and may not attempt to observe a deadlock, invocation order, or skipped invocation as the oracle.

review_rationale: batch103: independent fresh-context source review against pinned J3/24-007 (sha256 7371e889...). Reviewer read all 20 base units of 10.1.6.1, 10.1.6.2, 10.1.6.3, 10.1.7 and 10.1.8 in the original PDF rather than the author summary, verified 20 base / 56 fine units, 10 requirements and 63 facets (all pending), and separately re-read the 10.1.2.4, 10.1.2.6, 10.1.2.8 and 10.1.2.9 grammar units to confirm ownership. A global name-head check over 502 rule heads found 0 missing, 0 duplicate and 0 unmatched, and confirmed the defined-operator grammar owners remain R1004/C1005, R1024/C1006, R1012, R1020 and R1022. Every processor freedom is correctly recorded as a permission: 10.1.6.3 p1 equivalent-expression latitude is bounded by parenthesis integrity, 10.1.7 p1 records that a processor need not evaluate all operands or evaluate each entirely, and 10.1.8 p1 keeps the rewrite context as permission while preserving the normative requirement that a parenthesized expression be treated as a data entity. 10.1.7 p3 is the single restriction in scope, with its CRITICAL and END CRITICAL exceptions. This packet carries four delegations left open by earlier batches: defined-binary applicability and generic nonapplicability from 10.1.2.9, and the left-recursive grouping facets from 10.1.2.6 and 10.1.2.8, which are discharged through a value-observable non-associative defined extension rather than through truth tables, short-circuiting or side effects. Undefined-status effects are recorded as not value-observable by reading the entity, and finite samples are recorded as able to refute but never to prove the all-possible-primary-values equivalence of 10.1.6.3 p2. Decision: accept, no blocking findings; three non-blocking observations recorded in doc/source_audits/batch_103.json. This registers source accounting only: it is not fixture approval, it supplies no execution, and it approves no oracle.
